text.p: Sterling pushed to fresh two-month highs against the mark of 2.3525 after an earlier dip to support at 2.3460 marks.

Analysts said the break above Tuesday's high of 2.3505 marks could see the pound test the next upside target of 2.3550 but were also cautious of its overbought conditions with the RSI nearing the 70 percent threshold.

After clearing the 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement at 2.3410 marks on Tuesday and with a close above 2.35 marks today, analysts said there was little in its way to territory above 2.36 marks and beyond. Sterling support lies at 2.3460 marks and then at the previous retracement resistance at 2.3410.
The strong dollar kept cable soft with initial resistance at $1.5530 seen giving way to firmer support at $1.5510, an uptrendline from the early May lows.
A stronger pound will find resistance at the $1.5560-70 congestion zone ahead of psychological resistance at $1.56.
Above here, analysts said the June-July peaks around $1.5640 would keep further gains in check before retesting last week's highs above $1.57. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 6745
